title: Home
text:
Welcome to my portfolio. I am an undergraduate student in International Economic Relations at UFMG and a researcher at the Center for Legislative Studies (CEL-DCP/UFMG).
My work is centered on political-economic analysis and the evaluation of public policies. I build structured datasets and apply quantitative methods to analyze Executive-Legislative dynamics and their impacts on economic development and institutional frameworks.

title: About Me
text:
Page under construction! Here, I will detail my research projects and data pipelines applied to economics, political analysis, and public finance.
My technical background involves developing automated web scraping bots in R and Python to extract large-scale legislative and economic documents. I specialize in processing, cleaning, and structuring complex datasets to support evidence-based public policy analysis.
